title: drawcurve

arguments.description: line color, filled shapes have an extra first interior color
(x, y) pairs giving coordinates of each vertex

flags.name: -v <symbol>
flags.description: assigns a field to make it visible/invisible

flags.name: -xr
flags.description: disable mouse actions when in "run" mode

flags.name: -xe
flags.description: disable mouse actions when in "edit" mode

flags.name: -x
flags.description: set both "-xr" and "-xe", disabling all mouse actions

flags.name: -xv
flags.description: disable dragging vertices when in "run" mode (keeps reporting mouse clicks)

flags.name: -d
flags.description: dragging in interior displaces the entire scalar

body: [drawcurve] draws a curve for each scalar of the template it is in, through vertices given as x/y pairs in its arguments. The coordinates, color and line width can be field names, so each scalar can look different, and in run mode you can drag the vertices to change those fields. With -v, a field controls whether it is visible.
